baseline: Post Sprint 118 release candidate (S100-S118 complete): 362 API tests, web/Flutter release builds, encrypted restore drill and upgrade path verified.
objective: REPRODUCE -> RELEASE -> HARDEN -> VERIFY -> QUALITY -> EVALUATE without replacing the stack, weakening tenant isolation, or rewriting remote history.

steps: Approve or amend this draft roadmap.
Point scripts/sprint-batch/roadmap.mjs at docs/roadmap/KAIRO_V3_ROADMAP.json (or add explicit roadmap selection).
Update AGENTS.md read order and autopilot aliases from V2 to V3; mark V2 as historical.
Start a fresh batch; V3 numbering begins at 119 so V2 completion is inherited historically, not by state.

sprints.title: Reproducible Dependency And Image Supply Chain
sprints.goal: Prevent silent dependency drift like the Sprint 118 SQLAlchemy 2.1/greenlet production-image startup blocker.
tasks: Produce a committed Python constraints lock from requirements.txt on the supported interpreter and install production images from the lock.
Pin container base images (python:3.12-slim and the postgres/redis/minio references) to digests used by the release.

Add a CI job that builds the production api/worker image, starts api and worker against ephemeral postgres/redis, and asserts /health plus Celery readiness; the job fails when a container cannot start.
Add dependency vulnerability scanning (pip-audit and npm audit --omit=dev) with an explicit, documented failing policy for critical findings.
Document the procedure for refreshing the lock and digests.
Keep the tested workstation baseline and CI on the same resolved versions.
acceptance: The production image start smoke passes in CI and locally.
The lock installs the exact tested versions and pip check is clean inside the image.
A synthetic regression (removing the asyncio extra) is caught by the smoke without weakening any test.
Vulnerability scanning runs in CI and its policy is documented.

sprints.title: Release Operations Enablement
sprints.goal: Turn the release-candidate runbooks into rehearsable operations while keeping store, DNS and secret actions behind explicit human approval.
tasks: Add a staging deployment validation script for the Flutter Web staging compose stack with an end-to-end smoke (sign-in and core navigation).
Automate a rollback rehearsal in staging: deploy, create a backup, restore the previous archive, verify smoke, and keep evidence artifacts.
Produce an operator checklist for the HUMAN_REQUIRED items: Android upload keystore, Play Console internal testing, Flutter Web staging hostname promotion, historical JWT rotation.
Extend pilot_acceptance_preflight.ps1 to verify release artifacts and non-placeholder configuration without printing secrets.
Record evidence paths and approval gates in docs/operations/.
acceptance: Staging validation and rollback rehearsal run reproducibly and store evidence.
The checklist covers each human gate with exact commands and rollback criteria.
No production hostname, credential or store metadata is changed by the automation.

sprints.title: Windows Recovery Path Parity And Archive Integrity
sprints.goal: Remove the Windows-host recovery caveat found in Sprint 118 and guarantee every archive is verifiably restorable.
tasks: Replace host tar.exe archiving on Windows with a container-based archiver over the MinIO volume so archives match the Linux path.
Verify archive integrity immediately after creation and fail the backup when verification fails.
Harden Test-KairoRecoveryDrill.ps1: clean up extraction workspaces, exit non-zero on any failed step, and print a compact evidence summary.
Add a parity check proving the Windows archive contains the same component set as the Linux archive.
Update the recovery runbooks to the corrected commands.
acceptance: A Windows full backup (PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO) is created, verified and restored isolated without the bsdtar failure.
A tampered or truncated archive is rejected by the verification step.
Drill cleanup leaves no extracted operational data on disk.
No runbook mentions an obsolete command.

sprints.title: Outbox Crash Recovery And Stale Reclaim
sprints.goal: Guarantee that a worker crash mid-delivery cannot permanently strand outbox rows in processing.
tasks: Add stale reclaim for notification outbox and domain-event rows left in processing beyond a bounded age, returning them to pending with recorded reason and bounded attempts.
Preserve deduplication and idempotent projections: reclaim must never duplicate inbox rows, audit projections or finance effects.
Expose reclaimed counts through /metrics and /health details without user data.
Cover crash-and-recovery for both outboxes with tests, including attempts exhaustion.
Document the recovery semantics in the notification and domain-event operator guides.
acceptance: A processing row older than the reclaim threshold is retried and completed exactly once.
Reclaiming never duplicates notifications, audit entries or payments.
Metrics and health expose reclaimed counts safely.

sprints.title: Offsite Backup And Point-In-Time Recovery Validation
sprints.goal: Prove recovery beyond local disk: offsite destination plus WAL point-in-time recovery into an isolated target.
tasks: Automate the external S3-compatible upload against a configured endpoint only; fail closed when unconfigured and document it as an operator step.
Add a WAL/PITR drill restoring to a chosen timestamp in an isolated container with schema and row-count verification.
Schedule a periodic non-destructive drill (Celery beat) that records privacy-safe evidence in the tenant recovery centre.
Validate archive and WAL retention/rotation, reporting counts only.
Update the encrypted recovery runbook with tested commands and expected outputs.
acceptance: Offsite upload and retrieval succeed against a locally emulated S3 endpoint.
The PITR drill restores to a target timestamp and passes integrity checks.
The recovery centre shows the latest drill evidence.

sprints.title: Full-Stack Integration Smoke Track
sprints.goal: Add a real-stack integration layer between backend tests and the mocked browser packs.
tasks: Compose an integration environment (postgres, redis, minio, api, worker, web) with a deterministic seed.
Add an HTTP/browser smoke suite covering sign-in for every canonical role, tenant-isolation assertions, one finance lifecycle, one disciplinary read, the notification inbox and module toggles.
Run the suite on a schedule and on demand; document runtime and resource expectations.
Produce downloadable failure evidence (logs, screenshots) without exposing secrets.
acceptance: The suite passes against the real stack and fails when a seeded role boundary is broken.
No mocked API responses are used in this track.
Failure evidence artifacts are produced.

sprints.title: Internationalization Completion
sprints.goal: Close the remaining translation gap and make the coverage guard enforcing.
tasks: Move every remaining hardcoded user-facing string reported by check-i18n-coverage.mjs into FR/EN/DE catalogs or the view copy pattern with all three locales.
Remove the residual inline locale ternaries tracked since Sprint 108.
Convert check-i18n-coverage.mjs from informational to a failing gate with an explicit allowlist that must shrink.
Keep backend enum values untranslated and preserve locale parity.
acceptance: check-i18n-coverage.mjs exits non-zero with an empty or documented tiny allowlist.
FR/EN/DE parity holds for all catalogs and view copy objects.
The locale, role and release-candidate browser packs stay green.

sprints.title: Accessibility Depth And Role-Workspace Coverage
sprints.goal: Extend the Sprint 118 audit from the shell to every role workspace and add a repeatable manual protocol.
tasks: Run and fix axe WCAG 2.2 AA findings for every workspace reachable by the canonical roles at 320/390/1280 widths.
Add Flutter accessibility tests for the role shell, finance, discipline and inbox surfaces at 200% text scaling and dark mode.
Define a manual screen-reader protocol (NVDA and Android TalkBack) and record a pilot pass.
Add focus-order and keyboard-only journey checks for the main office workflows.
acceptance: The accessibility pack covers all role workspaces and passes.
The manual protocol is documented with results for at least one office role and one member role.
No regression in the locale, role or release-candidate packs.

sprints.title: Data Retention And Privacy Operations
sprints.goal: Give operators tenant-scoped retention and privacy operations that are auditable and never bypass authorization.
tasks: Add configurable retention windows per tenant for audit events, notification history, chat conversations and ingestion logs.
Implement member personal-data export and erasure workflows executed online in the backend, audited and restricted to authorised roles.
Keep statutory finance and disciplinary records out of erasure scope unless legally allowed; document the retention matrix.
Add tests proving tenant isolation, audit entries and role restrictions for every operation.
Run retention in the worker with idempotent, privacy-safe counts.
acceptance: Retention tasks run in the worker, are idempotent and log counts only.
Export and erasure are backend-only, role-gated, audited and covered by tests.
Documentation states what is retained and why.

sprints.title: Identity Federation Evaluation
sprints.goal: Decide, with evidence, whether OIDC/SAML federation belongs in the product and how it preserves tenant isolation.
tasks: Write an ADR evaluating OIDC/SAML against the existing identity module: provider abstraction, tenant mapping, role claims and session implications.
Build a spike against a local OIDC provider behind a feature flag that is never enabled by default.
Document threat-model impacts: token validation, replay, logout, MFA interaction and recovery paths.
Produce a go/no-go recommendation with estimated effort; do not ship federation to production in this sprint.
acceptance: The ADR exists with a clear recommendation and rejected alternatives.
The spike demonstrates login mapping in the test environment only.
No production behaviour changes while the flag is off.

sprints.title: Flutter Pilot Completion
sprints.goal: Finish the deferred pilot items so the Flutter client can enter a controlled internal-testing pilot.
tasks: Implement permanent member deletion parity behind the president/secretary role gate with its confirmation flow, consuming the existing API only.
Prepare Play Console internal-testing packaging assets: signed AAB checklist, store listing text in FR/EN/DE and data-safety answers.
Validate iOS/desktop architecture readiness with build checks and no release commitment.
Update docs/flutter/FEATURE_PARITY.md and the Flutter PROJECT_STATUS.md with evidence.
acceptance: Member deletion works through the API with role tests and updates the parity matrix.
Internal-testing assets are prepared; signing and store actions remain operator-gated.
iOS/desktop checks are documented as non-release validation.
